name: BSP_PlaneClass_ReadLuaFields
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. The plane family's override of descriptor vtable slot +8h. __thiscall(descriptor, LuaObject* row), RET 4; chains to 00960230 then reads 77 keys into +140h..+608h: ShortName, NumEngines +140h, JetEngines +144h, the aerodynamic block +164h..+1D8h, the ground block +1FCh..+208h, the effect handles +214h/+218h/+234h/+5A4h, BayDoor +5A8h..+5B0h, PartAnims +5C8h/+5D8h/+5E8h and the turbo block +5FCh..+608h. Key table in reports/vehicle_class_fields.json. | Decoded in full by packet plane_class_fields; see docs/PLANE_CLASS_FIELDS.md. __thiscall(descriptor in ECX, LuaObject* row at [ESP+16Ch]), RET 4 at 007D3E4F, body 007D1F70-007D3E51, 1853 instructions, 0 flow gaps. Chains to 00960230 at 007D1F9F, then 70 key paths over 77 GetByName sites into +138h..+608h of the 60Ch-byte plane descriptor. WheelHeight and GroundPitch are one gate: only when both are non-nil does 007D2A5E set the byte at +1F8h and convert both. TravelSpeed also writes +190h as tuning+334h times the value. Accel is scaled by tuning+320h*tuning+31Ch when tuning+31Ch>1.0f, and otherwise 007D213C writes 1.0f back into the shared tuning object. +218h holds the effect named by the LowPlaneAlt literal, from no key. GearsPullTime defaults to 2.0f, or 4.0f when the descriptor's IsKindOf accepts 10h (LevelBomber) or 16h (LargeReconPlane). PartAnims Gears/Wings/BayDoor are 10h-byte records {[1],[2],abs([1]-[2]) or [3],flag} at +5C8h/+5D8h/+5E8h. TurboStrength not strictly above 1.0f zeroes TurboTime at 007D3DB8, and its default is 1.0f. Nine callers via vtable slot +8h: 007D1E50, 007CFA30 and the eight plane leaf constructors. Installed-file check: 72 plane rows of 633; only Wreck and GearsPullTime are asked for and never shipped.

name: BSP_Plane_ReadPropertyBag
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_pilot_command_path, read-only analysis. __thiscall(unit), RET with no immediate, raw body 007D5D20-007D771E with NO Ghidra function: 007D5AC0's stored body really ends at its RET at 007D5D1F, 007D5D20 opens PUSH -1/MOV EAX,FS:[0]/PUSH 00C8D786/SUB ESP,744h/MOV ESI,ECX at 007D5D41, and the only RET in 007D5D20-007D771F is 007D771E after MOV FS:[0],ECX at 007D7710 and ADD ESP,750h, with int3 at 007D771F and the next defined function at 007D7720. Plane vtable +A0h (base 00D05F20). THIS IS THE ROUTINE THAT NAMES THE AXES: gated on unit+C0h existing with [unit+C0h]+4h == 3 (a Lua property bag) at 007D677F, it builds a 14h-byte reader on the stack at 007D6797, opens the group control (00D05DAC) with 00BD8E20 BSP_LuaReader_EnterKey at 007D696F, and reads each control-block field with 00BD6830 BSP_LuaReader_ReadField(reader, 0, key, 2, dest), pushing {2,and field} then {0,key}: unit+9F0h is pwrInput (007D6983/007D699F, 00D05DA0), unit+9E4h is yawInput (007D69BA/007D69D6, 00D05D94), unit+9ECh is rollInput (007D69F1/007D6A0D, 00D05D88), unit+9E8h is pitchInput (007D6A28/007D6A44, 00D05D7C), unit+9F4h is airBrakeInput (007D6A5F/007D6A7B, 00D05D6C), byte unit+9FAh is gunFire (007D6A90/007D6AB2, 00D05D64), byte unit+9F9h is turboInput (007D6ACD/007D6AE9, 00D05D58). The next group, dynamics (00D05D4C), names the latched copies the same way: unit+BB0h yawF, unit+BB4h pitchF, unit+BB8h rollF, unit+BBCh pwrF, unit+BC0h airBrakeF, matching the permutation of the latch 007B9770. Because ReadField writes its dest, this is a producer of unit+9E4h..+9FAh that bypasses both the command block and the quantiser. It also clears unit+C08h and byte unit+C0Ch (the 007BB9A0 gate) at 007D5D4C-007D5D52 and writes unit+900h at 007D63EA, 007D65DD, 007D6600 and 007D711A (that field is packet cc2_plane_ground_ops'). coverage: partial, only the Lua block 007D67CC-007D6CFF read. docs/PILOT_COMMAND_PATH.md
